comparison_rule: Per `@function` symbol of the emitted assembly, the lines from its label to its `.Lfunc_end` label, without assembler directives. Compiler-numbered local names are reduced to their kind: `.LBB<n>_`, `.LCPI<n>_`, `.LJTI<n>_`, `.Ltmp<n>`, `.Lfunc_begin<n>`, `.Lexception<n>` and `.Lanon.<hash>.<n>`; their numbers and hashes follow the crate's function count and source line positions. Mnemonics, operands, registers, immediates and label suffixes are compared verbatim.
